description: i-UR attributes written with the built-in schemas: a building read from an i-UR 3.2 dataset (Ogasawara, 2025) is written with the built-in iur-uro-3.2 and iur-urf-3.2 adeSchemas modules and no schemaLocation anywhere. Every uro: attribute must come back, uro:buildingIDAttribute (buildingID, prefecture, city) and uro:bldgDataQualityAttribute (lod1HeightType) included, and the root must declare uro and urf 3.2 at ../../schemas/iur/, where a dataset keeps them. The case ships a validation.xsd that reads i-UR from the writer's own bundle, so check-citygml-schema validates it offline. New-world only: the legacy writer cannot write the building's bldg:lod0RoofEdge (it reports citygml.geometry_not_written), a geometry gap unrelated to i-UR; its uro: output is identical.
